name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kecelakaan Kerja (work accident)
authority: PP 44/2015 Pasal 16(1): JKK by risk group — I 0.24%, II 0.54%, III 0.89%, IV 1.27%, V 1.74% of the wage, employer-borne. PP 37/2021 Pasal 11 as amended by PP 6/2025 funds JKP by recomposing 0.14% out of this rate; the employer is billed the full JKK rate and no separate JKP line (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan billing, and the seeded company's own listing). PP 44/2015 art.16(1) — an employer-only premium banded by the employer's registered work-risk group, in five groups from sangat rendah to sangat tinggi. PP 49/2023 art.16A, in force 6 October 2023, recomposes every rate by 0.14 percentage points into JKP for a wage earner required and registered in the JKP programme, giving 0.10 / 0.40 / 0.75 / 1.13 / 1.60; the art.16(1) rates 0.24 / 0.54 / 0.89 / 1.27 / 1.74 survive only for the art.16A(3) population, which this version does not model. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AS5` = 0.89% and `!AC5` = 0.24% — the art.16(1) rates for class III (sedang) and class I (sangat rendah). The actuals follow 0.89% — Sutoyo `AS8` 65,670 = 0.89% x 7,378,688 exactly, and the foreign employee `AO6` 551,800 = 0.89% x 62,000,000 exactly, at two wages three orders of magnitude apart — so the workbook's risk group is class III, not the class IV the company record states. See ID_JKK_RISK_CLASS_CONFLICT. NO CEILING: the premium is charged on the full 22,380,750 and on the full 62,000,000. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 44/2015 art.19(2), PP 45/2015 art.29(1), PP 46/2015 art.17(1), Perpres 82/2018 art.32: the contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base (`ALLOWANCES`); a reimbursement is not. name: BPJS Kesehatan (health insurance)
authority: Perpres 82/2018 art.30 as amended — 5% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 4% from the employer, charged on wage between a floor and a ceiling (Perpres 59/2024 art.32(1) and (2) — the third amendment, in force 8 May 2024 — restating the ceiling and floor; art.31 was deleted by Perpres 64/2020 and art.30(2) is the direct-payment rule). The floor art.32(2) states is the workplace UMK, with the UMP only as the art.32(3) fallback; Applied 2026-09-18: `by_region` carries the Kabupaten Bekasi UMK (Kepgub Jabar 2026) beside the UMP, and the company’s region names it, so the floor is the workplace UMK. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AP5` = 1% (employee) and `!AU5` = 4% (employer); `!AG5` prints the combined 5%. The 12,000,000 ceiling is read off two employees — see ID_BPJS_CEILINGS_OBSERVED. The art.30(2) FLOOR is carried by `FLOOR:MINIMUM_WAGE` against this version's `minimum_wages` map, which `company.region` keys; the source is silent on it, the lowest basic salary anywhere in the workbook being 5,938,885, so no row in the source is floored. Perpres 82/2018 art.5(3)–(4) and art.36: a further family member (a fourth child, a parent, a parent-in-law) is enrolled at the worker's election and costs 1% of the wage each, paid by the worker; carried as a rate override on the registration, never charged from the household count. One employee pays exactly 2% in every month; a dependant count is not a `rate_selector` axis. See ID_KESEHATAN_EXTRA_FAMILY_MEMBERS. art.5(3)–(4) and art.36: a further family member (a fourth child, a parent, a parent-in-law) is enrolled at the worker's election and costs 1% of the wage each, paid by the worker; carried as a rate override on the registration, never charged from the household count. authority: PP 37/2021 Pasal 11 as amended by PP 6/2025: the JKP contribution is 0.36% of the wage capped at Rp5,000,000 (Pasal 11(7)–(8)), of which 0.22% is the central government's and 0.14% is recomposed out of the JKK contribution the employer already pays; nothing is charged on a payslip beyond JKK. PP 37/2021 art.43 as amended by PP 6/2025 art.11, in force 7 February 2025 — 0.36% of the monthly wage, of which 0.22% is borne by the Central Government and 0.14% comes from recomposing JKK (PP 49/2023 art.16A). JKP is open to Indonesian nationals under 54 whose employer is not in contribution arrears (the rule `when`; a NOT_REGISTERED fact for arrears). Neither nationality nor JKP registration is a `rate_selector` axis; both belong on employment_statutory_facts. name: Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 (income tax withholding)
authority: PP 58/2023 and PMK 168/2023, in force 1 January 2024 — for every tax period but the last, a permanent employee's withholding is the monthly average effective rate (tarif efektif rata-rata, TER) for the employee's PTKP category applied to monthly gross. Category A is PTKP TK/0 (54,000,000) and TK/1 & K/0 (58,500,000), 44 brackets; category B is TK/2 & K/1 (63,000,000) and TK/3 & K/2 (67,500,000), 40 brackets; category C is K/3 (72,000,000), 41 brackets — all transcribed from the PMK 168/2023 Lampiran. Employee JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are charged as their own schemes and are not read as a relief on this scheme’s base: PMK 168/2023 art.15 applies the TER to gross. The last tax period is the first rung: the annual UU PPh art.17(1)(a) progression on PKP = year gross − biaya jabatan (5%, at most 6,000,000; PMK 250/PMK.03/2008) − the year's employee JP and JHT (PMK 168/2023 art.10(3)(b), iuran terkait program pensiun dan hari tua kepada BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) − PTKP, PKP rounded down to the whole thousand (UU PPh art.17(4)), less the year's withholding, a negative charge being the refund. Employer-borne JKK, JKM and the 4% Kesehatan are additions to the taxable gross (`produced.<code>.employer` in `assessed_on`). Applied 2026-09-18: employer-borne JKK, JKM and BPJS Kesehatan premiums are additions to the gross (PMK 168/2023 art.5(1)); in the five labour-intensive sectors an employee with a monthly gross up to 10,000,000 has the PPh 21 borne by the government for the 2025 and 2026 tax periods (PMK 10/2025, PMK 105/2025; entity fact `pph21_dtp_sector`), so nothing is withheld from them. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): UU 36/2008 art.7(1): the PTKP dependant count is the dependants in a direct line of blood or marriage and adopted children, at most three (`employee.dependents_count`, capped), not the children on record; PMK 168/2023 art.10(2): biaya jabatan is 5% to Rp 500,000 a month, so the year’s cap is 500,000 for each month employed (`year.months_employed`); PMK 10/2025 art.2: the Government-borne PPh 21 is for a gross fixed and regular income of at most Rp 10,000,000 in the month (`BASE` and the fixed allowances), not the whole taxable base; PP 68/2009: severance (pesangon, UPMK) is taxed at its own final rates and is outside the TER base; a non-resident is under PPh 26.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Hari Tua (old-age savings)
authority: PP 46/2015 art.16 — 5.7% of the monthly wage, 2% from the employee and 3.7% from the employer. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AO5` = 2% (employee) and `!AR5` = 3.7% (employer); `!AE5` prints the combined 5.7%. NO CEILING: the highest-paid local employee, basic 22,380,750, is charged `AO17` 447,615 = 2% of the FULL wage, and the one foreign employee at 62,000,000 is charged `AK6` 1,240,000 = 2% of the full wage. Both would be clamped if any ceiling applied, and neither is. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 44/2015 art.19(2), PP 45/2015 art.29(1), PP 46/2015 art.17(1), Perpres 82/2018 art.32: the contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base (`ALLOWANCES`); a reimbursement is not. Where the KDIT listing charged the wage alone (JHT on 22,380,750 for KDIT0002), the law charges 27,880,750.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kecelakaan Kerja (work accident)
authority: PP 44/2015 Pasal 16(1): JKK by risk group — I 0.24%, II 0.54%, III 0.89%, IV 1.27%, V 1.74% of the wage, employer-borne. PP 37/2021 Pasal 11 as amended by PP 6/2025 funds JKP by recomposing 0.14% out of this rate; the employer is billed the full JKK rate and no separate JKP line (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan billing, and the seeded company's own listing). PP 44/2015 art.16(1) — an employer-only premium banded by the employer's registered work-risk group, in five groups from sangat rendah to sangat tinggi. PP 49/2023 art.16A, in force 6 October 2023, recomposes every rate by 0.14 percentage points into JKP for a wage earner required and registered in the JKP programme, giving 0.10 / 0.40 / 0.75 / 1.13 / 1.60; the art.16(1) rates 0.24 / 0.54 / 0.89 / 1.27 / 1.74 survive only for the art.16A(3) population, which this version does not model. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AS5` = 0.89% and `!AC5` = 0.24% — the art.16(1) rates for class III (sedang) and class I (sangat rendah). The actuals follow 0.89% — Sutoyo `AS8` 65,670 = 0.89% x 7,378,688 exactly, and the foreign employee `AO6` 551,800 = 0.89% x 62,000,000 exactly, at two wages three orders of magnitude apart — so the workbook's risk group is class III, not the class IV the company record states. See ID_JKK_RISK_CLASS_CONFLICT. NO CEILING: the premium is charged on the full 22,380,750 and on the full 62,000,000. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 44/2015 art.19(2), PP 45/2015 art.29(1), PP 46/2015 art.17(1), Perpres 82/2018 art.32: the contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base (`ALLOWANCES`); a reimbursement is not. Where the KDIT listing charged the wage alone (JHT on 22,380,750 for KDIT0002), the law charges 27,880,750.

name: BPJS Kesehatan (health insurance)
authority: Perpres 82/2018 art.30 as amended — 5% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 4% from the employer, charged on wage between a floor and a ceiling (Perpres 59/2024 art.32(1) and (2) — the third amendment, in force 8 May 2024 — restating the ceiling and floor; art.31 was deleted by Perpres 64/2020 and art.30(2) is the direct-payment rule). The floor art.32(2) states is the workplace UMK, with the UMP only as the art.32(3) fallback; Applied 2026-09-18: `by_region` carries the Kabupaten Bekasi UMK (Kepgub Jabar 2026) beside the UMP, and the company’s region names it, so the floor is the workplace UMK. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AP5` = 1% (employee) and `!AU5` = 4% (employer); `!AG5` prints the combined 5%. The 12,000,000 ceiling is read off two employees — see ID_BPJS_CEILINGS_OBSERVED. The art.30(2) FLOOR is carried by `FLOOR:MINIMUM_WAGE` against this version's `minimum_wages` map, which `company.region` keys; the source is silent on it, the lowest basic salary anywhere in the workbook being 5,938,885, so no row in the source is floored. Perpres 82/2018 art.5(3)–(4) and art.36: a further family member (a fourth child, a parent, a parent-in-law) is enrolled at the worker's election and costs 1% of the wage each, paid by the worker; carried as a rate override on the registration, never charged from the household count. One employee pays exactly 2% in every month; a dependant count is not a `rate_selector` axis. See ID_KESEHATAN_EXTRA_FAMILY_MEMBERS. art.5(3)–(4) and art.36: a further family member (a fourth child, a parent, a parent-in-law) is enrolled at the worker's election and costs 1% of the wage each, paid by the worker; carried as a rate override on the registration, never charged from the household count. name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kehilangan Pekerjaan (job loss)
authority: PP 37/2021 Pasal 11 as amended by PP 6/2025: the JKP contribution is 0.36% of the wage capped at Rp5,000,000 (Pasal 11(7)–(8)), of which 0.22% is the central government's and 0.14% is recomposed out of the JKK contribution the employer already pays; nothing is charged on a payslip beyond JKK. PP 37/2021 art.43 as amended by PP 6/2025 art.11, in force 7 February 2025 — 0.36% of the monthly wage, of which 0.22% is borne by the Central Government and 0.14% comes from recomposing JKK (PP 49/2023 art.16A). Only that recomposed 0.14% is an employer charge: JKK class III 0.75 + JKM 0.30 + JKP 0.14 = 1.19% of wage, the same total the source workbook's 0.89 + 0.30 charges; only the composition of the payslip lines moves. JKP is open to Indonesian nationals under 54 whose employer is not in contribution arrears (the rule `when`; a NOT_REGISTERED fact for arrears). Neither nationality nor JKP registration is a `rate_selector` axis; both belong on employment_statutory_facts. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 37/2021 art.4 covers an Indonesian national under 54 (`citizenship`, `age`); a NOT_REGISTERED fact takes an employment out where the employer is not current. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 44/2015 art.19(2), PP 45/2015 art.29(1), PP 46/2015 art.17(1), Perpres 82/2018 art.32: the contribution wage is upah pokok plus tunjangan tetap — the standing car, housing and special allowances are in the base (`ALLOWANCES`); a reimbursement is not. Where the KDIT listing charged the wage alone (JHT on 22,380,750 for KDIT0002), the law charges 27,880,750.

name: Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 (income tax withholding)
authority: PP 58/2023 and PMK 168/2023, in force 1 January 2024 — for every tax period but the last, a permanent employee's withholding is the monthly average effective rate (tarif efektif rata-rata, TER) for the employee's PTKP category applied to monthly gross. Category A is PTKP TK/0 (54,000,000) and TK/1 & K/0 (58,500,000), 44 brackets; category B is TK/2 & K/1 (63,000,000) and TK/3 & K/2 (67,500,000), 40 brackets; category C is K/3 (72,000,000), 41 brackets — all transcribed from the PMK 168/2023 Lampiran. Employee JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are charged as their own schemes and are not read as a relief on this scheme’s base: PMK 168/2023 art.15 applies the TER to gross. The last tax period is the first rung: the annual UU PPh art.17(1)(a) progression on PKP = year gross − biaya jabatan (5%, at most 6,000,000; PMK 250/PMK.03/2008) − the year's employee JP and JHT (PMK 168/2023 art.10(3)(b), iuran terkait program pensiun dan hari tua kepada BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) − PTKP, PKP rounded down to the whole thousand (UU PPh art.17(4)), less the year's withholding, a negative charge being the refund. Employer-borne JKK, JKM and the 4% Kesehatan are additions to the taxable gross (`produced.<code>.employer` in `assessed_on`). Applied 2026-09-18: employer-borne JKK, JKM and BPJS Kesehatan premiums are additions to the gross (PMK 168/2023 art.5(1)); in the five labour-intensive sectors an employee with a monthly gross up to 10,000,000 has the PPh 21 borne by the government for the 2025 and 2026 tax periods (PMK 10/2025, PMK 105/2025; entity fact `pph21_dtp_sector`), so nothing is withheld from them. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): UU 36/2008 art.7(1): the PTKP dependant count is the dependants in a direct line of blood or marriage and adopted children, at most three (`employee.dependents_count`, capped), not the children on record; PMK 168/2023 art.10(2): biaya jabatan is 5% to Rp 500,000 a month, so the year’s cap is 500,000 for each month employed (`year.months_employed`); PMK 10/2025 art.2: the Government-borne PPh 21 is for a gross fixed and regular income of at most Rp 10,000,000 in the month (`BASE` and the fixed allowances), not the whole taxable base; PP 68/2009: severance (pesangon, UPMK) is taxed at its own final rates and is outside the TER base; a non-resident is under PPh 26.

name: Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 (income tax withholding)
authority: PP 58/2023 and PMK 168/2023, in force 1 January 2024 — for every tax period but the last, a permanent employee's withholding is the monthly average effective rate (tarif efektif rata-rata, TER) for the employee's PTKP category applied to monthly gross. Category A is PTKP TK/0 (54,000,000) and TK/1 & K/0 (58,500,000), 44 brackets; category B is TK/2 & K/1 (63,000,000) and TK/3 & K/2 (67,500,000), 40 brackets; category C is K/3 (72,000,000), 41 brackets — all transcribed from the PMK 168/2023 Lampiran. Employee JHT (2%) and JP (1%) are charged as their own schemes and are not read as a relief on this scheme’s base: PMK 168/2023 art.15 applies the TER to gross. The last tax period is the first rung: the annual UU PPh art.17(1)(a) progression on PKP = year gross − biaya jabatan (5%, at most 6,000,000; PMK 250/PMK.03/2008) − the year's employee JP and JHT (PMK 168/2023 art.10(3)(b), iuran terkait program pensiun dan hari tua kepada BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) − PTKP, PKP rounded down to the whole thousand (UU PPh art.17(4)), less the year's withholding, a negative charge being the refund. Employer-borne JKK, JKM and the 4% Kesehatan are additions to the taxable gross (`produced.<code>.employer` in `assessed_on`). Applied 2026-09-18: employer-borne JKK, JKM and BPJS Kesehatan premiums are additions to the gross (PMK 168/2023 art.5(1)); in the five labour-intensive sectors an employee with a monthly gross up to 10,000,000 has the PPh 21 borne by the government for the 2025 and 2026 tax periods (PMK 10/2025, PMK 105/2025; entity fact `pph21_dtp_sector`), so nothing is withheld from them. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): UU 36/2008 art.7(1): the PTKP dependant count is the dependants in a direct line of blood or marriage and adopted children, at most three (`employee.dependents_count`, capped), not the children on record; PMK 168/2023 art.10(2): biaya jabatan is 5% to Rp 500,000 a month, so the year’s cap is 500,000 for each month employed (`year.months_employed`); PMK 10/2025 art.2: the Government-borne PPh 21 is for a gross fixed and regular income of at most Rp 10,000,000 in the month (`BASE` and the fixed allowances), not the whole taxable base; PP 68/2009: severance (pesangon, UPMK) is taxed at its own final rates and is outside the TER base; a non-resident is under PPh 26.

rules.when: person.terms.tax_residency != "NON_RESIDENT" && base > 0.0

authority: PP 68/2009 art.2–4: severance pay (uang pesangon, uang penghargaan masa kerja) paid at once is subject to a final PPh 21 — 0% to Rp 50,000,000, 5% to 100,000,000, 15% to 500,000,000, 25% above — separately from the monthly TER withholding; the tiers accumulate over payments within two years, which this row reads as one payment.
